import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Product distribution
product_counts = data['product'].value_counts()
axes[0, 0].bar(product_counts.index, product_counts.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Product Distribution')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Product')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales by payment method
payment_totals = data.groupby('payment_method')['total'].sum()
colors = ['#2E8B57', '#4682B4']
axes[0, 1].pie(payment_totals.values, labels=payment_totals.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
               colors=colors, startangle=90)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales by Payment Method')

# 3. Customer age group distribution
age_counts = data['customer_age_group'].value_counts()
axes[0, 2].barh(age_counts.index, age_counts.values, color='#FF6347')
axes[0, 2].set_title('Customer Age Group Distribution')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Count')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Age Group')

# 4. Sales by hour
data['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(data['time'], format='%H:%M').dt.hour
hourly_sales = data.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
axes[1, 0].plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', 
                linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#9370DB')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sales by Hour')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Size preference
size_counts = data['size'].value_counts()
axes[1, 1].bar(size_counts.index, size_counts.values, color=['#FFD700', '#FFA500', '#FF4500'])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Size Preference')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Size')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Count')

# 6. Takeaway vs Dine-in
takeaway_data = data['is_takeaway'].value_counts()
takeaway_labels = ['Takeaway' if x == 1 else 'Dine-in' for x in takeaway_data.index]
axes[1, 2].pie(takeaway_data.values, labels=takeaway_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
               colors=['#20B2AA', '#F08080'], startangle=90)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
